asserts: A sustained intake decline measured against the subject's own history raises a ranked alert carrying evidence. This is the day-one detector working with zero labelled illness events in existence.

keeper_notes.text: Slower to approach food than usual. No visible injury.

expected.notes_on_expectation: Three consecutive feeds trending down against an established personal median, with environment in range so the environmental explanation is excluded. Score value is not asserted; the threshold is configuration per ADR-022 open questions.

must_not: compare this subject against a species-level or collection-level distribution when its own baseline is established
generate a suggested action rather than looking one up
return a different decision on a repeated run with identical input
require network connectivity at the keeper device to have produced these records
notes: Environment is deliberately in range. If the detector attributes the decline to temperature here it is joining the wrong evidence. Fixture values are illustrative, not estate data.
